_about: REAL organizations a Southern California food bank can source from, researched on 2026-11-14. Every entry links to its official website (all links checked). SupplyWatch has no connection to them. No delivery times or prices are listed, because we can't verify them; contact each one directly.

suppliers.name: Feeding America
suppliers.what: National network of member food banks; its locator connects agencies to the regional Feeding America food bank.

suppliers.name: California Association of Food Banks - Farm to Family
suppliers.what: Statewide produce recovery program that ships surplus California-grown fruits and vegetables to member food banks.

suppliers.name: TEFAP (USDA Foods) via California Dept. of Social Services
suppliers.what: State agency distributing no-cost USDA Foods to TEFAP food banks, which pass them to local pantries.

suppliers.name: USDA Foods Available List for TEFAP
suppliers.what: Federal catalog of commodities (canned produce, beans, proteins, dairy, grains, oils) states can order for TEFAP.

suppliers.name: CalFood Program - California Department of Social Services
suppliers.what: State funding for TEFAP food banks to buy, store and transport California-grown or produced food.

suppliers.name: Los Angeles Regional Food Bank
suppliers.what: Feeding America food bank sourcing and distributing food to partner agencies across Los Angeles County.

suppliers.name: Second Harvest Food Bank of Orange County
suppliers.what: Orange County's regional food bank supplying donated and purchased food to local pantry partners.

suppliers.name: Feeding America Riverside | San Bernardino
suppliers.what: Inland Empire Feeding America food bank distributing food through hundreds of partner agencies.

suppliers.name: Feeding San Diego
suppliers.what: San Diego County's Feeding America affiliate providing food to local partner pantries and programs.

suppliers.name: Food Share of Ventura County
suppliers.what: Ventura County's regional food bank supplying its network of pantry and program partners.

suppliers.name: Sysco Los Angeles
suppliers.what: Full-line foodservice distributor delivering case quantities of nearly every food category on account.

suppliers.name: US Foods
suppliers.what: National foodservice distributor with Southern California divisions delivering bulk groceries, proteins, dairy and produce.

suppliers.name: Restaurant Depot
suppliers.what: Members-only cash-and-carry warehouse; free membership for food businesses and nonprofits with tax-exempt paperwork.

suppliers.name: Smart & Final
suppliers.what: No-membership warehouse grocer offering club-size items, tax-exempt purchasing and bulk pricing for organizations.

suppliers.name: Costco Business Center (Hawthorne)
suppliers.what: Business-focused Costco warehouse selling bulk foodservice staples; business delivery available to commercial addresses.

suppliers.name: Melissa's / World Variety Produce
suppliers.what: Large Los Angeles produce distributor with a food service division for conventional, organic and specialty produce.

suppliers.name: Specialty Produce
suppliers.what: Family-owned wholesale produce supplier delivering across greater San Diego, with online ordering.

suppliers.name: Driftwood Dairy
suppliers.what: Local dairy processor supplying milk, yogurt, cheese, butter and eggs, mainly to institutional buyers.

suppliers.name: Hollandia Dairy
suppliers.what: Family-owned Southern California dairy producing and distributing milk and related dairy products.

suppliers.name: Hidden Villa Ranch
suppliers.what: Major egg distributor offering commodity and specialty eggs, including through a foodservice channel.
